items.value: Featuring a 20"(shoulder to hem measured size s) short jacket design, Full zip up and stand collar,bungee at hem and keep the cold out,Baggy,Cropped length,Perfect winter outfit for your jeans, legging, or any pants.

items: Baggy and cropped seaming brings a flattering bottom. High neck with full-zip offers more skin coverage protection against chill wind and sun.

items.label: The Fit
items.value: Baggy relaxed fit, cropped-length to the upper navel,which perfect with high-rise pants
